name: Divorce And Forgiveness
overview: Scripture reveals God's deep displeasure with divorce, emphasizing that He hates the act of putting away a spouse, as seen in Malachi 2:16 where it is described as an act of treachery and violence. At the same time, the New Testament calls believers to a heart of forgiveness, teaching that forgiving others is essential for receiving God's forgiveness (Matthew 6:14). Jesus further instructs His followers to forgive repeatedly, highlighting the importance of continual mercy in relationships (Matthew 18:21). Together, these verses underscore the call to uphold the sanctity of marriage while extending grace and forgiveness within brokenness.
